matching_method: Case-insensitive repository + PR number; normalize -NUMBER, _NUMBER and _prNUMBER; style uses original_instance_id or pull_number.
limitations: No exhaustive semantic matching of different PRs addressing the same issue.
No inference about contamination in student pretraining.
Patch comparisons sample one NVIDIA trajectory per overlapping base PR, plus all three primary trajectory reference patches.
Counts apply only to the pinned dataset revisions.
